sources.title: Bitcoin Crash Wipes $1.7B From MARA
sources.snippet: Bitcoin Price Drop Hits MARA's Balance Sheet MARA disclosed a $1.71 billion net loss for the fourth quarter of 2025 in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, driven largely by falling crypto prices. The firm cited a significant decline in the fair value of its digital assets as Bitcoin slid sharply from its October peak near $126,000 to roughly $65,000.

sources.title: MARA Stock Skyrockets 16% Even as the Bitcoin Miner Took a $1.7B - TipRanks
sources.snippet: MARA Holdings stock jumped more than 16% because investors felt excited about a new deal to build AI data centers, which helped them ignore a huge $1.7 billion loss. The stock market had a surprise for investors today. MARA Holdings MARA +0.99% , formerly Marathon Digital Holdings, stock skyrocketed by over 16% in a single day.
